summary: Himalaya Shipping Ltd., a Bermuda-incorporated bulk carrier, filed a Form 6-K with an attached press release disclosing the exercise of 25,000 share options by a program participant at a strike price of USD 5.83 per share. The board resolved to issue 25,000 new shares to satisfy the obligation, subject to Euronext Rule Book II compliance. This routine equity issuance under an employee option program is not a special situation; it involves no strategic transaction, premium, or deal structure. The company will announce when conditions are met and shares issued. No special-situation angle exists—a routine capital increase under a share option plan.
